packages.name: Xatu

packages.name: Lamictal
packages.reveal: Brand name for lamotrigine, an anticonvulsant.

packages.name: Agumon
packages.reveal: A Digimon. Wrong franchise, officer.

packages.name: Probopass
packages.reveal: A Rock/Steel Pokémon with a magnetic mustache.

packages.name: Ditropan
packages.reveal: Oxybutynin — treats overactive bladder.

packages.name: Klefki
packages.reveal: A Pokémon that is literally a keyring.

packages.name: Fexoprax
packages.reveal: Totally made up. Sounds legit though, right?

packages.name: BILLY
packages.reveal: IKEA's iconic bookcase, on sale since 1979.

packages.name: Göteborg
packages.reveal: Gothenburg — Sweden's second-largest city.

packages.name: Hygge
packages.reveal: A Danish word for cosiness. Wrong Scandinavian country.

packages.name: BLÅHAJ
packages.reveal: The cuddly IKEA shark. The name literally means 'blue shark'.

packages.name: Kiruna
packages.reveal: Sweden's northernmost town — its centre is being physically moved to make room for an iron mine.

packages.name: POÄNG
packages.reveal: The bentwood armchair, around since 1976.

packages.name: Flumbjörk
packages.reveal: Invented. Sounds exactly like a nightstand, doesn't it?

packages.name: Megadeth
packages.reveal: Thrash metal, founded by Dave Mustaine after he left Metallica.

packages.name: Pterodactyl
packages.reveal: A flying pterosaur — a reptile, but not a dinosaur.

packages.name: Mastodon
packages.reveal: A metal band from Atlanta. The real mastodon was a mammal, not a dinosaur.

packages.name: Parasaurolophus
packages.reveal: A duck-billed dinosaur with a long, hollow head crest.

packages.name: Gojira
packages.reveal: French metal band named after Godzilla's Japanese name.

packages.name: Triceratops
packages.reveal: Three horns, one frill, zero metal albums.

packages.name: Dimetrodon
packages.reveal: Sail-backed and in every toy dino set — but it's a synapsid, closer to mammals than to dinosaurs.

packages.name: Dunder Mifflin
packages.reveal: The paper company from The Office.

packages.name: Juicero
packages.reveal: Real. Its Wi-Fi juicer cost up to $699 — and the juice packs could be squeezed by hand.

packages.name: Skynet
packages.reveal: Skynet is the AI in The Terminator. The company that built it was Cyberdyne Systems.

packages.name: Quibi
packages.reveal: Real. Raised about $1.75 billion and shut down roughly six months after launch.

packages.name: Hooli
packages.reveal: The evil tech giant from HBO's Silicon Valley.

packages.name: Wayne Enterprises
packages.reveal: Bruce Wayne's company. Funds a suspicious number of gadgets.

packages.name: Aperture Science
packages.reveal: Fictional — but from the Portal video games, not TV or film.

packages.name: Gilderoy Lockhart
packages.reveal: The vain Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher.

packages.name: Titania
packages.reveal: Queen of the fairies in A Midsummer Night's Dream.

packages.name: Oberyn
packages.reveal: Oberyn Martell is from Game of Thrones. You're thinking of Oberon.

packages.name: Mundungus Fletcher
packages.reveal: Petty thief and (reluctant) member of the Order of the Phoenix.

packages.name: Malvolio
packages.reveal: The cross-gartered steward in Twelfth Night.

packages.name: Rubeus Hagrid
packages.reveal: Keeper of Keys and Grounds at Hogwarts. A breather, officer.

packages.name: Quillbert Mudgewort
packages.reveal: Invented. Nobody in either canon is called that.

packages.name: Farfalle
packages.reveal: Bow-tie pasta. 'Farfalle' means butterflies.

packages.name: Esposito
packages.reveal: Hugely common around Naples — historically given to abandoned children.

packages.name: Risotto
packages.reveal: A rice dish. Not pasta, not a surname.

packages.name: Strozzapreti
packages.reveal: Real pasta. The name means 'priest stranglers'.

packages.name: Ferrari
packages.reveal: A surname long before it was a car — from 'ferraro', blacksmith.

packages.name: Spaghetti
packages.reveal: 'Little strings', from spago. You knew this one.

packages.name: Bresaola
packages.reveal: Air-dried, salted beef from Lombardy. Delicious contraband.

packages.name: Helvetica
packages.reveal: The Swiss sans-serif that's on half the signs you've ever read.

packages.name: Zoloft
packages.reveal: Sertraline, a common SSRI antidepressant.

packages.name: Lorem Ipsum
packages.reveal: Placeholder text, not a font. Scrambled Cicero, actually.

packages.name: Xeljanz
packages.reveal: Tofacitinib, used for rheumatoid arthritis.

packages.name: Advil
packages.reveal: Ibuprofen sold over the counter. No prescription needed.

packages.name: Comic Sans
packages.reveal: Yes, it's a font. Yes, it's real. A breather.

packages.name: Candara
packages.reveal: A humanist sans-serif Microsoft shipped with Windows Vista.
